live_doc_rules: Live doc targets must be concrete file paths under Plans/ that exist in the repository workspace.
Ignore paths under Plans/.pipeline/, Plans/_shards/, and Plans/.evidence/; exclude archives, sentinels, and non-Plans paths as Section E live doc targets.
When exact_paths_mentioned contains qualifying Plans/** paths, enumerate live_doc_windows using max_lines_per_live_doc_window on the actual checked-in files.
